name: Shenzhen Mason Technologies Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Mason Technologies Co.,Ltd operates as a global enterprise, focusing on the entire lifecycle of high-end LED technology, from research and development to the design, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced LED light source packaging and application lighting products. Its comprehensive product offerings feature various LED fixtures such as streetlights, tunnel lights, high bay luminaires, floodlights, and robust three-proof lighting, alongside components like LED plug-ins and patches. In addition to its core lighting business, the company extends its services to professional real estate management, digital marketing for home furnishing, and specialized communication solutions. Founded in 2002, the firm is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
